visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page-top rotating spotlight carousel: full-bleed photo slides with an overlaid heading and CTA, plus a title navigator built from the slides
visualCharacteristics.layout: Full-bleed photo slides with overlaid white heading/CTA and an overlapping white title-list navigator (red active bar), unlike a standard image+text carousel.

contentPattern.description: 4 rotating photo-background slides with heading + CTA and a 'Spotlight stories' slide navigator.
contentPattern.structure: Optional single-cell row: navigator title (e.g. Spotlight stories). Each following row is a slide: cell 1 image; cell 2 optional short nav label paragraph, heading, description, CTA link
contentPattern.notes: Slide 2's navigator label differs from its heading; author it as a short paragraph before the heading in the text cell so the block can use it as the nav label (falls back to the heading).

usage: Page-top rotating spotlight carousel: full-bleed photo slides with an overlaid heading and CTA, plus a title navigator built from the slides.
reuseGuidance: Use for rotating photo heroes with 2+ slides. Use hero for a single static banner.
labels: Screen-reader labels can be overridden with page metadata keys carousel-label-role-description, carousel-label-previous, carousel-label-next, carousel-label-controls, carousel-label-show-slide (use {index} and {total}).
